scope: Known marker number+image-position scoring; automatic text-anchor check only for insertions. Full baseline anchor not independently scored. All inserted groups require pixel audit, especially unmatched annotations.
decision: REMAIN_BACKUP; controlled false-insertion requirement failed: candidate2correct/6patches,4false; true additions in1/6documentIDs. No deployable or robust generalization claim.
primary_score_note: full_hit uses localized numeral center, but Vision ranges may have whole-word boxes; it is a geometric proxy and NOT full-page textual citation recall. Do not interpret union_hit as independently validated end-to-end accuracy.
